create_config_modelopt_fp8: create a ModelOptFp8Config from a quantization config dict for static FP8 diffusion checkpoints
create_config_modelopt_fp4: create a ModelOptFp4Config from a quantization config dict for NVFP4 quantization
apply_quant_fp8_linear: apply ModelOptFp8LinearMethod to run FP8 quantized linear inference with scales and bias
apply_quant_fp4_linear: apply ModelOptFp4LinearMethod to run NVFP4 quantized GEMM with CUTLASS or FlashInfer backend
test_layer_exclusion: test if a layer prefix matches any exclude_modules patterns in ModelOptQuantConfig
